message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. The facts involve extensive theft of motorcycles, other items, cash, weapons, ammunition, military ammunition, etc. Also theft of military ammunition, firearms parts, explosives (雷管). Also theft of bank cards, etc. So primary charge: 盗窃 (theft). Also there is possession of stolen goods? But they sold them. Also "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" may apply for selling stolen goods? In many examples, they include both 盗窃 and 掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得 when there is concealment or selling. Here they stole many items and sold them. So likely both 盗窃 and 掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得. Also there is illegal possession of military ammunition and firearms? They stole bullets, rifle ammo, hand gun ammo, and a rifle? Actually they stole "藏刀2把，雷管1包，手枪子弹6发， 小口径子弹6发， 长子弹1发，共计13发子弹（其中11发为军用子弹）". That's illegal possession of ammunition, maybe also illegal possession of firearms? They didn't have a gun, just ammunition and explosives. The charge list includes "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" but not separate for ammunition only. There's "非法持有毒品" etc. For ammunition, maybe "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药". That label appears earlier for gun possession. So could apply. Also "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" is a label. So we may include that.

Also "非法占用农用地" not relevant. "非法狩猎" not. "非法收购、运输、加工、出售国家重点保护植物" not.

Thus charges: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益;非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药

Check if any other: "抢劫" no. "诈骗" no. "走私" no. "非法占有" maybe but theft covers.

Thus final answer list.
